caption: The drawing features two gray lace-up boots and a single brown boot sole, set against a light beige background. The boots are depicted from a side view, one facing left and the other facing right, with visible stitching and a brown interior lining. Both boots have a distinct reddish-brown strip above the black outer sole at the toe area and dark brown wooden heels. The brown boot sole, shown below the boots, is oriented with the heel at the bottom and includes detailed nail marks and stitching. The objects are arranged in a triangular formation, with the sole in the lower left corner and the two boots above and to the right. The name "Majel G. Claflin - Taos - N.M." is written in black ink towards the bottom right of the image.
title: Copper-toed Child's Shoe
